decision: Applications migrate in waves based on criticality and provisioning readiness.
rationale: A readiness-based sequence reduces operational risk and avoids blocking the program on difficult legacy apps.

decision: Role-based access is baseline, with governed exceptions.
rationale: Common role models simplify access review while allowing controlled exceptions for legitimate edge cases.

decision: Harbor provides an interim SSO bridge for the Atlas pilot.
rationale: Atlas can pilot without waiting for the full identity modernization while still using enterprise controls.

decision: Legacy apps without SCIM are not forced into phase 1.
rationale: Custom provisioning for every legacy app would overload the first migration wave and increase risk.

decision: Privileged accounts require step-up controls before migration.
rationale: Administrative access has materially higher blast radius and needs stronger assurance before cutover.
